verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸੁਰ ਭਭੀਖਣੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਦਰੁ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਵਿਖਲੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: asur bhabheekhan bhagat hai bidhar dhraoo vikhalee saranaiee|

en.bdb: Saint Vibhisaa a demon, and Vidur son of maid servant came in the shelter of the Lord. Dhanni is known as a jai

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸਧਨਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਕਸਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)naa jaT vakhaaneeaai sadhanaa jaat ajaat kasaiee|

en.bdb: And Sadhana was an out caste butcher. Saint Kabir was a weaver

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੁਲਾਹੜਾ ਨਾਮਾ ਛੀਂਬਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: bhagat kabeer julaahaRaa naamaa chhee(n)baa har gun gaiee|

en.bdb: And Namdev a calicoprinter who sang the praises of the Lord. Ravidas was a cobbler and saint Sairt belonged to (the so-called ) low barber caste.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਲਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਚਮਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੈਣੁ ਸਨਾਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kul ravidhaas chamaar hai sain sanaatee a(n)dhar naiee|

en.bdb: Female crow takes care of the fledgelings of nightingale but they ultimately meet their own family.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇਲ ਪਾਲੈ ਕਾਵਣੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਕੁਲ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: koil paalai kaavanee a(n)t milai apane kul jaiee|

en.bdb: Though Yagoda nurtured Krsna, yet he came to be known as the lotus (son) ) of the family of Vasudev.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸਨੁ ਜਸੋਧਾ ਪਾਲਿਆ ਵਾਸਦੇਵ ਕੁਲ ਕਵਲ ਸਦਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kisan jasodhaa paaliaa vaasadhev kul kaval sadhaiee|

en.bdb: As the pot of any type containing ghee is not said to be bad,

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਿਅ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਭਗਤਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਨਾਤ ਨ ਕਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: ghia bhaa(n)ddaa na veechaareeaai bhagataa jaat sanaat na kaiee|

en.bdb: Likewise, the saints also have no high or low caste whatsoever.
They all remain in the shelter of the lotus feet of the true Guru.
